steps.name: apply-stage18c2-runtime-golden-parity
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=839508852e1327bbcf96a02bfa5e6fa6e183ff4d; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; rm -f warnings.txt; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage18/apply_stage18c2_golden_runtime_parity.py > /tmp/apply-stage18c2-runtime-parity.py; .venv/bin/python /tmp/apply-stage18c2-runtime-parity.py; .venv/bin/python tools/ml/generate_climate_runtime_parity.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix tools/ml/generate_climate_runtime_parity.py tests/test_climate_runtime_parity.py; .venv/bin/python -m ruff format tools/ml/generate_climate_runtime_parity.py tests/test_climate_runtime_parity.py; .venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files test/test_climate_runtime_parity/test_main.cpp tests/fixtures/climate_runtime_parity_generated.h || true; .venv/bin/pre-commit run clang-format --files test/test_climate_runtime_parity/test_main.cpp tests/fixtures/climate_runtime_parity_generated.h; git diff --check; git status --short
